name: Discover the Portable Mini Sealing Machine: a handheld food sealer for snacks and chips, featuring a rechargeable Type-C
description:
Material: Plastic

Color: Multicolor

Product Dimensions: 5L × 10W × 10H cm

Item Weight: 100 g

Power Source: Battery Powered, Rechargeable

Charging Time: 1–2 hours

Charging Backup / Working Time: 2–3 hours

Included Accessories: USB charging cable, manual book

Description:
Compact, lightweight, and colorful, this AAOVEFOX product is made of durable plastic and rechargeable for convenience. With a quick 1–2 hour charging time, it provides 2–3 hours of usage. Perfect for daily use, and includes a USB cable and manual for easy setup.
